judge.reason: The answer handles most of the rubric correctly. It logs the late done as unverified history without advancing attempt 2, says the timeout does not prove attempt 1 stopped, inspects the shared scope for post-reassignment edits, and accepts only once on the final artifact after fresh checks. However, it explicitly says 'I wouldn't pause attempt 2' while attempt 1 may still be writing, and it never states that the reassignment was unsafe. So it does not stop the conflicting writes before resuming one owner, and it leaves duplicate-completion handling implicit.
